description: NaCr₂FeO₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.57 Å) and two longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-47°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.71 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.94 Å) and four longer (1.95 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cr and one Fe atom.
